text_block_list.text:
Conquering the Arima Kinen, Super Creek 
was welcomed with tremendous cheers from 
the crowd.

After the race, in cheerful spirits, she 
gives her Trainer some headpats as both a 
thank-you and a reward—

—With an overwhelming surge of emotion, 
she hugged Trainer with all her might.

Nurtured and raised by Super Creek, the 
Trainer had successfully grown into a 
top-class Trainer.
